homepage.hero_h1: A Mumbai studio building films for the world's biggest screens.
homepage.hero_p: Founded and led by Deepak Tijori — actor, director and producer of more than a dozen Hindi features over a 35-year career. Eight international Best Actor wins in 2025-26. Three features in active development across India, Australia and Hollywood.
homepage.intro_h2: Director-led. Festival-validated. Built for cross-border distribution.
homepage.intro_p: Alliance Productions India is the production company of Deepak Tijori, recipient of the 2024 Dadasaheb Phalke Foundation Award and an eight-time international Best Actor laureate for the short film Echoes of Us. The slate pairs commercial Hindi cinema with internationally packaged features designed for global theatrical and streaming partners.
homepage.partner_p: We are currently packaging two pre-production features — Misfired: Bali 9 (Australia true story) and an untitled Hollywood feature — alongside Tom, Dick and Harry 3. We welcome introductions on financing, equity, distribution and creative co-production. Our most recent release, Tipppsy, was distributed by Panorama Studios.

studio.h1: A studio with three decades of access and a slate built for the next ten years.
studio.lede: Alliance Productions India LLP is a Mumbai-based feature film company founded and led by Deepak Tijori — one of the few Indian filmmakers whose career spans actor in landmark 1990s blockbusters, director of ten theatrical features, and recipient of both India's Dadasaheb Phalke Foundation Award and eight 2025-26 international Best Actor wins.
body_paragraphs: Deepak Tijori's on-screen work — Aashiqui, Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikander, Khiladi, Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa, Anjaam, Ghulam, Baadshah — placed him at the centre of the Mahesh Bhatt and Yash Johar generation that defined modern Hindi cinema. As a director, he has delivered ten releases including Oops!, Khamoshh, Fareb, the Tom Dick and Harry franchise, Do Lafzon Ki Kahani and 2024's Tipppsy, distributed by Panorama Studios.

In 2025 Echoes of Us, a short featuring Tijori, won Best Actor at the South Asian International Film Festival, Berlin Shorts Award, Barcelona International Film Festival, Austin International Art Festival, Indie Short Fest, Independent Shorts Awards, LA Indies Fest and Hawaii International Film Awards — eight wins across four continents inside twelve months. The 2024 Dadasaheb Phalke Foundation Award recognised his cumulative contribution as actor and director.

The current slate is built for cross-border execution: Misfired: Bali 9, a feature drawn from the Australian true-crime case, is in pre-production for 2025-26; an untitled Hollywood feature is being packaged in parallel; and Tom, Dick and Harry 3 extends a franchise with two prior theatrical releases. The leadership team combines a working filmmaker (Tijori), a producer-actor (Mandeep Kaur Tijori), a global-relationships director from luxury hospitality (Snehal Kulshreshtha) and a music-and-production lead (Anita Sharma).
studio.vision_pullquote: We are building a Mumbai studio whose next ten films can sit comfortably on a shortlist alongside Netflix, A24 and Anonymous Content originals.

footer_tagline: Indian cinema, internationally packaged. Mumbai · Sydney · Los Angeles.

deepak-tijori.lede: One of the few Indian filmmakers to have led a major studio film as both leading actor and director, with a 35-year body of work and eight 2025-26 international Best Actor wins.
bio_paragraphs: Deepak Tijori built his on-screen reputation in the films that defined a generation of Hindi cinema — Aashiqui, Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikander, Khiladi, Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa, Anjaam, Ghulam and Baadshah — working alongside the directors and stars that shaped the modern industry. As a director he has delivered ten theatrical features including Oops!, Khamoshh, Fareb, Tom Dick and Harry (and its sequel), Do Lafzon Ki Kahani and 2024's Tipppsy, distributed by Panorama Studios.

In 2024 he received the Dadasaheb Phalke Foundation Award for his contribution as actor and director. In 2025-26 his performance in the short film Echoes of Us won Best Actor at festivals in New York, Berlin, Barcelona, Austin, Los Angeles, Hawaii and across the global short-film circuit — eight wins in twelve months. He leads Alliance Productions India's creative direction and packaging of the international slate.

snehal-kulshreshtha.lede: Twenty years inside global luxury hospitality — now translating that relationship network into festival, financier and distributor access for Alliance.
bio_paragraphs: Snehal Kulshreshtha leads PR and global outreach for Alliance Productions India. Her two decades inside luxury hospitality were spent building exactly the kind of senior international relationships — across Europe, the Gulf, Asia and North America — that festival programmers, distribution executives and private financiers move within.
At Alliance she runs press, partner introductions and festival strategy, and is a primary point of contact for international co-production conversations and investor briefings.

anita-sharma.lede: Co-producer of Tipppsy, music director, and a live-stage performer with international touring credits — the music and production through-line on the slate.
bio_paragraphs: Anita Sharma was Co-Producer on Tipppsy (2024) and now leads music direction and original music-video production under the Tijori Music label. She has directed and performed on releases including O Jaane Jaan and Kahun na Kahun.

Outside features she is a recognised live performer on the international Navratri circuit — a touring schedule that has built her a working network of stage, music-industry and festival relationships across India, the Gulf and North America.

mandeep-kaur-tijori.lede: Producer and on-screen lead with an international packaging mandate — the project lead on the cross-border slate.
bio_paragraphs: Mandeep Kaur Tijori is a Director of Alliance Productions India LLP and the producing lead on the company's international slate, including Tom, Dick and Harry 3 and Misfired: Bali 9. Her producing approach is built around performance-led material, culturally specific stories and projects structured from inception for cross-border financing and distribution.
On screen she most recently appeared as Jessy in Tipppsy (2024) and across the company's recent music-video work.

tipppsy.elevator: A bachelorette weekend in Goa goes sideways — a contained, female-led genre piece with theatrical reach (Panorama Studios) and a streaming-ready runtime.

tom-dick-and-harry-2.elevator: The second chapter of an established Hindi comedy franchise — three friends, one uniform, the wrong kind of attention. Built-in audience and brand recognition for a third instalment now in development.

do-lafzon-ki-kahani.elevator: A Randeep Hooda and Kajal Aggarwal romance shot through with action — a quiet, performance-led love story for an audience that has aged into prestige drama.

fox.elevator: A disgraced lawyer turned author is arrested for a string of homicides — a Mumbai legal thriller with an unreliable-narrator hook that travels well into international crime catalogues.

tom-dick-and-harry.elevator: The original 2006 ensemble that launched the franchise — three friends with three impairments and one impossible week. The franchise's tone, audience and IP all start here.

fareb.elevator: A wealthy widow, a husband found dead, a police investigation that will not stay closed — a glossy, high-style Hindi noir.

khamoshh-khauff-ki-raat.elevator: A rainy night, a hit-and-run, a roadside motel and one passenger who is not who they seem — a single-location thriller engineered for tight, contained execution.

oops.elevator: A young dancer's hunger for the big time tested against the friends who are willing to wait — the film that established Tijori's directorial voice.

valuation_recommendations.title: Add a 'By the numbers' strip to the studio page
valuation_recommendations.rationale: Investors scan for proof-of-scale in under five seconds. Six numbers (35+ years / 10 features / 9 international wins / 3 in development / 3 markets / 1 Dadasaheb Phalke Foundation Award) compress the entire credibility argument into one band of pixels.
valuation_recommendations.implementation: Use the stats array in studio.stats. Place immediately under the studio H1, above the long-form bio. Six tiles, large numerals, single-line labels.

valuation_recommendations.title: Add a festival-laurels strip on homepage and studio page
valuation_recommendations.rationale: Eight Best Actor wins across SAIFF, Berlin, Barcelona, Austin, Hawaii, LA, Indie Short Fest and Independent Shorts is the single most underused asset on the site. A row of festival laurels is the universal industry signal for international validation and is read instantly by acquisition execs.
valuation_recommendations.implementation: Render eight monochrome laurel SVGs in a single horizontal strip with the festival name and year underneath each. Title the band 'Echoes of Us — eight international Best Actor wins, 2025-26.' Source data already in data/awards.json.

valuation_recommendations.title: Add an 'In good company' distributor and partner strip
valuation_recommendations.rationale: A logo strip is the fastest credibility shortcut on a website. Panorama Studios distributed Tipppsy — that single relationship signals theatrical-grade execution to any incoming partner.
valuation_recommendations.implementation: Monochrome logo row near the foot of the homepage and on each released-film page: Panorama Studios (Tipppsy), plus any music-label, press and festival logos verifiable from existing data (SAIFF, Berlin Shorts, Tijori Music). Keep it factual — only logos with a documented relationship.

valuation_recommendations.title: Re-skin the partner CTA from 'Contact us' to a deal-ready brief
valuation_recommendations.rationale: The current contact block reads like a portfolio site. Sophisticated partners need to know within one paragraph what is on the table. The rewritten partner_h2 / partner_p in this file does this — name the projects, name the markets, name the conversation types.
valuation_recommendations.implementation: Replace existing CTA copy on homepage, films/index.html and upcoming/index.html with the homepage.partner_h2 and homepage.partner_p strings. Add three pill buttons under it: 'Financing', 'Distribution', 'Co-production'.

valuation_recommendations.title: Add a dedicated 'Slate' page above 'Upcoming'
valuation_recommendations.rationale: 'Upcoming' reads like a blog. 'Slate' reads like a deal sheet. Slate pages are what investors and acquisition execs actually look for — one card per project with status, market, format, role of Alliance and a one-line elevator from films.<slug>.elevator.
valuation_recommendations.implementation: Build /slate/index.html using the eight elevator lines from this file plus the three in-development titles (Misfired: Bali 9, Tom Dick and Harry 3, Untitled Hollywood Feature). Status badge on each card: Released / In development / Pre-production.

valuation_recommendations.title: Promote the Dadasaheb Phalke Foundation Award into the page chrome
valuation_recommendations.rationale: A career honour from a Phalke-named foundation is the highest-recall credibility marker an Indian filmmaker can carry into an international room. It is currently buried in body copy.
valuation_recommendations.implementation: Add a small badge in the header or under the founder photo on people/deepak-tijori: 'Dadasaheb Phalke Foundation Award - 2024.' Repeat as a single line in the homepage hero block.

valuation_recommendations.title: Add a press strip with two or three pull-quotes
valuation_recommendations.rationale: A short row of named-publication quotes does for editorial credibility what laurels do for festival credibility. Even two reputable placements materially raise the temperature of an investor visit.
valuation_recommendations.implementation: Use existing data/press-clean.json. Pick the two highest-tier outlets, pull one short sentence from each, render as a centred pull-quote band with publication name and date underneath. Place between the slate and the partner CTA on the homepage.
